title.zh: Claude 开发商 Anthropic 筹备上市，估值或达1.5万亿美元
title.en: Claude-maker Anthropic poised for stock market debut worth up to $1.5tn

summary.zh: 人工智能公司 Anthropic 正筹备上市，估值最高可能达1.5万亿美元。该公司成立仅五年，凭借 Claude 成为 AI 领域主要参与者。
summary.en: Anthropic, the maker of Claude, is preparing for a stock market debut that could value it at up to $1.5 trillion. Founded five years ago, it has become one of the biggest names in artificial intelligence.

reports.title: Claude-maker Anthropic poised for stock market debut worth up to $1.5tn

title.zh: Anthropic 据报以每股83美元定价 IPO，高于预期区间
title.en: Anthropic reportedly prices IPO at $83 a share, above projected range

summary.zh: 据报道，Anthropic 将其 IPO 定价为每股83美元，高于此前预期区间。按完全稀释口径计算，公司估值达1.5万亿美元。
summary.en: Anthropic has reportedly priced its IPO at $83 per share, above the projected range. The listing values the company at $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis.

reports.title: Anthropic reportedly prices IPO at $83 a share, above projected range

title.zh: Gemini 4 Neon
title.en: Gemini 4 Neon

summary.zh: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Neon 模型，官方博客介绍相关进展；该消息在 Hacker News 获 497 分、461 条评论，引发关注。
summary.en: Google has introduced Gemini 4 Neon, according to a company blog post. The announcement drew significant attention on Hacker News, with 497 points and 461 comments.

reports.title: Gemini 4 Neon
Gemini 4 Neon looks like an Opus 5.5 competitor

title.zh: Nginx 曝未授权远程代码执行漏洞
title.en: Unauthenticated remote code execution in Nginx

summary.zh: 安全社区披露 Nginx 存在两个未授权远程代码执行漏洞（CVE-2026-123633 与 CVE-2026-123007）。由于 Nginx 部署极广，该议题在技术社区引发高度关注，讨论热度居高不下。
summary.en: Two CVEs, CVE-2026-123633 and CVE-2026-123007, describe unauthenticated remote code execution flaws in Nginx. Given the server's huge deployment base, the disclosure drew intense discussion in the security community.

reports.title: Unauthenticated remote code execution in Nginx

title.zh: 克里米亚大桥再次遭袭，俄官员称交通暂停
title.en: Crimean Bridge attacked again, Russian official says

summary.zh: 克里米亚地区负责人表示，连接俄罗斯与被占领土的大桥再次遭到袭击，交通已暂停。事件具体细节尚待进一步确认。
summary.en: The head of Crimea said traffic was suspended after another attack on the bridge linking Russia to the occupied territory. Further details were not immediately available.

reports.title: Crimean Bridge attacked again, Russian official says

title.zh: 微软CEO纳德拉解释为何要求6万名员工离职
title.en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains why he asked 60K employees to quit

summary.zh: 微软CEO纳德拉解释，公司10月向6万名员工提供买断方案、鼓励自愿离职，而非再次大规模裁员。他表示原因与AI有关，但并非外界预期的方式。
summary.en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explained why the company offered buyouts to 60,000 employees in October, encouraging voluntary departures instead of another mass layoff. He said the reason is AI, but not in the way people might expect.

reports.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains why he asked 60K employees to quit
Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella remains confident in Nvidia after Huang’s exit

title.zh: 缅甸因罗兴亚人大屠杀在联合国法院面临历史性种族灭绝裁决
title.en: Myanmar faces historic genocide verdict at UN court over Rohingya massacres

summary.zh: 联合国法院将就缅甸对罗兴亚人的种族灭绝指控作出历史性裁决。此前从未有国家被国际法院判定犯有种族灭绝罪，案件结果受到关注。
summary.en: Myanmar faces a historic genocide verdict at a UN court over massacres of Rohingya. No state has ever been found guilty of genocide by an international court, making the case significant.

reports.title: Myanmar faces historic genocide verdict at UN court over Rohingya massacres

title.zh: 以军在加沙“黄线”以外发动罕见地面行动
title.en: Israeli military launches rare ground operation in Gaza beyond Yellow Line

summary.zh: 以色列军方在加沙“黄线”以外发动罕见地面行动，称正拆除一条“恐怖隧道”。哈马斯谴责此举是“公然”违反停火协议。
summary.en: The Israeli military has launched a rare ground operation in Gaza beyond the Yellow Line, saying it is dismantling a “terror tunnel.” Hamas condemned the incursion as a “flagrant” violation of the ceasefire.

reports.title: Israeli military launches rare ground operation in Gaza beyond Yellow Line

title.zh: 欧盟提议向乌克兰提供450亿欧元贷款，以缓解现金危机并增强防御
title.en: EU proposes €45bn loan for Ukraine to avert cash crisis and boost defences

summary.zh: 欧盟委员会提议在2027年向乌克兰提供450亿欧元贷款，以缓解其迫在眉睫的现金危机并加强防御。冯德莱恩称，此举旨在让基辅在谈判中握有更强筹码，并表示相信27个成员国都会支持。
summary.en: The European Commission has proposed a €45bn loan to Ukraine for 2027 to ease a looming cash crisis and bolster its defences amid continued Russian bombardment. Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said the move would give Kyiv a stronger negotiating position and expressed confidence that all 27 member states would support it.

reports.title: EU proposes €45bn loan for Ukraine to avert cash crisis and boost defences

title.zh: Genie 4 现已发布
title.en: Genie 4 is now available

summary.zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Genie 4 现已可用，相关消息在 Hacker News 获得关注。给定信息未详述该模型的具体能力与开放范围。
summary.en: Google DeepMind has announced that Genie 4 is now available. The release drew attention on Hacker News, though details of its capabilities and access were not included in the source.

reports.title: Genie 4 is now available

title.zh: 微软Ignite 2026发布七款新模型，主打可扩展性价比
title.en: Seven new models at scalable price-performance

summary.zh: 微软在Ignite 2026活动上发布七款新模型，强调可扩展的性能价格比。该消息在技术社区获得较高关注，讨论涉及模型能力、定价和应用场景。
summary.en: Microsoft announced seven new models at Ignite 2026, emphasizing scalable price-performance. The announcement drew significant attention in the tech community, with discussion focused on model capabilities, pricing, and practical applications.

reports.title: Seven new models at scalable price-performance

title.zh: 微软 ONNX Runtime 已从 GitHub 上消失
title.en: Microsoft's ONNX Runtime has disappeared from GitHub

summary.zh: 有消息称，微软的 ONNX Runtime 项目页面已从 GitHub 消失，引发开发者关注。该仓库是广泛使用的机器学习推理运行时，目前原因尚不明确。
summary.en: Microsoft's ONNX Runtime repository appears to have disappeared from GitHub, drawing attention from developers. The widely used machine-learning inference runtime's removal has not been explained.

reports.title: Microsoft's ONNX Runtime has disappeared from GitHub

title.zh: 《GTA 6》登陆澳大利亚，玩家盛赞“完整鲜活、可自由呼吸的世界”
title.en: GTA 6 dazzles gamers in Australia with 'fully lived-in, breathable world'

summary.zh: 时隔十余年，《GTA 6》正式发售，澳大利亚玩家熬夜涌入以迈阿密为原型的罪恶都市。游戏中可装修房屋、修车、健身并推进剧情，评测称赞其开放世界真实鲜活、细节丰富。
summary.en: After more than a decade in development, Grand Theft Auto VI has launched, with Australian players staying up late to explore the Miami-inspired Vice City. The game lets players renovate houses, fix cars and lift weights, and reviewers praise its detailed, lived-in open world.

reports.title: GTA 6 dazzles gamers in Australia with ‘fully lived-in, breathable world’

title.zh: 全美最大学区考虑弃用谷歌搜索
title.en: The nation’s largest school districts consider ditching Google Search

summary.zh: 纽约、洛杉矶和芝加哥学区正考虑改用谷歌搜索的替代方案。谷歌表示，明年起学校若选择关闭Gemini人工智能功能，将无法同时保留搜索服务。此举引发对教育场景中AI、隐私与管控的担忧。
summary.en: New York, Los Angeles and Chicago school districts are considering Google Search alternatives. Google says schools that opt out of its Gemini AI features will also lose Search starting next year. The policy raises concerns about AI, privacy and control in education.

reports.title: The nation’s largest school districts consider ditching Google Search

title.zh: 利用OpenAI模型推进芯片设计
title.en: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models

summary.zh: OpenAI发布文章，介绍如何利用其模型推进芯片设计。该话题在Hacker News引发讨论，获得167分和106条评论。
summary.en: OpenAI published an article on advancing chip design with its models. The topic drew discussion on Hacker News, with 167 points and 106 comments.

reports.title: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models

title.zh: 审计试验显示：AI智能体提问质量胜过毕马威会计师
title.en: AI agents ask better questions than KPMG accountants in audit trial

summary.zh: 据《欧洲商业杂志》报道，在一项审计试验中，AI智能体提出的问题质量被认为优于毕马威的会计师。该消息在Hacker News上引发热议，获得369点及164条评论。
summary.en: In an audit trial reported by European Business Magazine, AI agents reportedly asked better questions than KPMG accountants. The item drew 369 points and 164 comments on Hacker News, sparking debate about AI's role in auditing.

reports.title: AI agents ask better questions than KPMG accountants in audit trial

title.zh: DNS 解析器不是打击盗版的正确战场
title.en: DNS resolvers are the wrong place to fight piracy

summary.zh: Quad9 因法国法院要求其屏蔽盗版网站而宣布退出法国市场，认为 DNS 解析器不应承担版权执法职能。此事再次引发外界对 DNS 层面内容过滤的争议。
summary.en: Quad9 is pulling out of France after a court order required it to block piracy sites, arguing that DNS resolvers should not be used for copyright enforcement. The case has reignited debate over DNS-level content filtering.

reports.title: DNS resolvers are the wrong place to fight piracy

title.zh: 摩根大通：发达市场财政赤字将创二战以来非衰退时期最高
title.en: Developed-market fiscal deficit to hit highest since World War 2 outside recessions, J.P. Morgan says - Reuters

summary.zh: 摩根大通指出，发达经济体财政赤字占GDP比重将升至二战以来除衰退年份外的最高水平。这反映财政扩张与借贷压力上升，可能对债券市场和政策前景产生影响。
summary.en: J.P. Morgan says developed-market fiscal deficits will reach their highest level since World War 2 outside recessions. The forecast points to rising fiscal expansion and borrowing pressures that could affect bond markets and policy outlooks.

reports.title: Developed-market fiscal deficit to hit highest since World War 2 outside recessions, J.P. Morgan says - Reuters

title.zh: 基于能量的推理器：推理效率提升385倍
title.en: Energy-Based Reasoners: 385x more efficient inference

summary.zh: 一篇研究介绍“基于能量的推理器”，称其推理效率比对照方法高385倍。该内容在 Hacker News 获301分、52条评论，引发技术社区关注。
summary.en: A research project introduces “Energy-Based Reasoners,” claiming 385x more efficient inference than a baseline. The item drew 301 points and 52 comments on Hacker News.

reports.title: Energy-Based Reasoners: 385x more efficient inference

title.zh: AI 正在杀死 All About Berlin：一个独立网站作者的控诉
title.en: AI is killing All About Berlin

summary.zh: 独立柏林生活指南网站 All About Berlin 的作者发文称，AI 正在让他的网站走向死亡。该文在 Hacker News 获得 760 分、685 条评论，引发关于 AI 搜索摘要与内容抓取如何冲击独立内容创作者的讨论。
summary.en: The author of All About Berlin, an independent guide to life in Berlin, writes that AI is killing his site. The post drew 760 points and 685 comments on Hacker News, sparking discussion about how AI search summaries and content scraping hurt independent publishers.

reports.title: AI is killing All About Berlin

title.zh: 美国国税局登录须接受 ID.me 条款
title.en: ID.me terms required for IRS sign-in

summary.zh: 美国纳税人须接受第三方身份验证服务 ID.me 的服务条款，才能登录国税局在线账户办理业务。消费者权益记录指出，这一强制要求引发对数据收集、隐私保护及替代方案缺失的担忧。
summary.en: U.S. taxpayers must accept ID.me's terms of service to sign in to IRS online accounts, a consumer-rights wiki entry notes. The requirement raises concerns about third-party identity verification, data collection and the lack of alternatives for filing or managing taxes online.

reports.title: ID.me terms required for IRS sign-in

title.zh: 俄国防部：一架俄军运输机在西伯利亚坠毁，19人死亡
title.en: Russian military transport aircraft crashes in Siberia, 19 dead, defence ministry says - Reuters

summary.zh: 俄罗斯国防部称，一架俄军运输机在西伯利亚坠毁，造成19人死亡。事故原因尚未公布，相关调查正在进行。
summary.en: Russia’s defence ministry says a Russian military transport aircraft crashed in Siberia, killing 19 people. The cause of the crash has not been disclosed, and an investigation is underway.

reports.title: Russian military transport aircraft crashes in Siberia, 19 dead, defence ministry says - Reuters

title.zh: jQuery 发布 4.1.0 版本
title.en: jQuery 4.1.0

summary.zh: jQuery 正式发布 4.1.0 版本，更新细节已在 GitHub 上公布。该版本发布在 Hacker News 上引发讨论，获得 372 分、199 条评论。
summary.en: jQuery has released version 4.1.0, with release details published on GitHub. The announcement drew 372 points and 199 comments on Hacker News.

reports.title: jQuery 4.1.0

title.zh: 《寄生虫》投资方等韩国媒体、游戏和旅游股因对华贸易协议上涨
title.en: 'Parasite' backer and other South Korean media, gaming and travel stocks rally on China trade deal

summary.zh: 韩国媒体、游戏和旅游股上涨，市场寄望对华贸易协议带来更多中国市场准入。《寄生虫》投资方等相关公司股价走强。
summary.en: South Korean media, gaming and travel stocks rallied on hopes that a China trade deal will improve access to the Chinese market. The rally included the backer of 'Parasite' and other sector companies.

reports.title: 'Parasite' backer and other South Korean media, gaming and travel stocks rally on China trade deal
文化传媒板块短线拉升 - 第一财经

title.zh: 梵高画作以创纪录1.904亿美元成交，此前因其纳粹时期历史引发争议
title.en: Van Gogh painting sells for record $190.4m after row over its Nazi history

summary.zh: 梵高1890年画作《开花的栗树》以1.904亿美元成交，创下纪录。此次拍卖前，该画作的纳粹时期历史曾引发争议。
summary.en: Vincent van Gogh’s 1890 painting Châtaigniers en fleurs sold for a record $190.4 million. The sale followed a dispute over the work’s Nazi-era history.

reports.title: Van Gogh painting sells for record $190.4m after row over its Nazi history

title.zh: 报告：Mike Lynch超级游艇存在未识别的强风脆弱性
title.en: Mike Lynch’s superyacht had unidentified vulnerability to high winds, report finds

summary.zh: 英国海事事故调查局最终报告称，沉没于西西里附近的“贝叶斯”号超级游艇存在易被强风倾覆的脆弱性，但船员并不知情，因为该艇从未在收帆锚泊状态下接受评估。事故造成包括科技大亨Mike Lynch及其女儿在内7人死亡。
summary.en: The UK MAIB’s final report found that the Bayesian, which sank off Sicily and killed seven including Mike Lynch and his daughter, was vulnerable to knockdown. Crew were unaware because the yacht had never been assessed at anchor with sails down.

reports.title: Mike Lynch’s superyacht had unidentified vulnerability to high winds, report finds

title.zh: 俄罗斯男子因涉嫌监视美国防务公司Palantir在美被捕
title.en: Russian arrested for spying on US defence company Palantir over Ukraine support

summary.zh: 美国检方称，一名俄罗斯男子因涉嫌监视防务公司Palantir被捕。嫌疑人跟踪该公司员工，并被发现持有假美国身份证件和两本俄罗斯护照。案件与Palantir支持乌克兰有关。
summary.en: A Russian man has been arrested in the US for allegedly spying on defence company Palantir over its support for Ukraine. Prosecutors say he followed employees and was found with fake US IDs and two Russian passports.

reports.title: Russian arrested for spying on US defence company Palantir over Ukraine support

title.zh: 赫格塞思访问委内瑞拉 吹嘘美军抓获马杜罗
title.en: Hegseth uses Venezuela visit to boast of Maduro’s capture by US military

summary.zh: 美国国防部长赫格塞思首次访问委内瑞拉，借机吹嘘美军特种部队抓获前总统马杜罗，称其为拉美史上最精密军事行动。马杜罗于1月3日凌晨被三角洲部队带走，引发争议。
summary.en: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth used his first visit to Venezuela to boast that US special forces captured former president Nicolás Maduro, calling it Latin America’s most sophisticated military operation. Maduro was seized by Delta Force on 3 January, a controversial move.

reports.title: Hegseth uses Venezuela visit to boast of Maduro’s capture by US military

title.zh: 英伟达拖累股市下跌，美元小幅走高
title.en: Stocks slip with Nvidia, dollar ticks higher - Reuters

summary.zh: 股市因英伟达走低而下跌，美元小幅走高。报道未提供更多细节，市场表现总体温和。
summary.en: Stocks slipped, weighed down by Nvidia, while the dollar edged higher. The report offered few additional details, indicating modest market moves.

reports.title: Stocks slip with Nvidia, dollar ticks higher - Reuters

title.zh: 德国部长驳斥美国对基辅纵深打击的批评，称其“愚蠢”
title.en: German minister rejects US criticism of Kyiv's deep strikes as 'stupid' - Reuters

summary.zh: 德国一名部长拒绝美国对乌克兰纵深打击的批评，并称相关指责“愚蠢”。路透社报道未披露更多细节。
summary.en: A German minister rejected US criticism of Ukraine’s deep strikes as “stupid,” according to Reuters. The report provided no further details.

reports.title: German minister rejects US criticism of Kyiv's deep strikes as 'stupid' - Reuters

title.zh: 港股科网股持续走低
title.en: Hong Kong tech and internet stocks continue to decline

summary.zh: 港股科技网络股延续下跌态势，第一财经报道。原文未披露具体跌幅及原因。
summary.en: Hong Kong technology and internet stocks continued to fall, according to Yicai. The source did not provide specific declines or reasons.

reports.title: 港股科网股持续走低 - 第一财经

title.zh: 胡又文卸任国联民生研究所所长，执行副总裁熊雷鸣将分管研究业务
title.en: Hu Youwen Steps Down as Head of Guolian Minsheng Research Institute; Executive VP Xiong Leiming to Oversee Research

summary.zh: 国联民生研究所所长胡又文卸任，公司执行副总裁熊雷鸣将分管研究业务。此次调整涉及该券商研究业务的管理职责分工。
summary.en: Hu Youwen has stepped down as director of Guolian Minsheng Research Institute. Executive Vice President Xiong Leiming will take charge of the research business. The change reshapes management responsibilities at the securities firm's research unit.

reports.title: 胡又文卸任国联民生研究所所长，执行副总裁熊雷鸣将分管研究业务 - Jiemian.com

title.zh: A股三大股指午后齐涨，科创50涨超2%，算力硬件、算力租赁大反弹，恒指跌1%，京东大跌7%
title.en: A-share three major indices rise in afternoon; STAR 50 up over 2%; computing-power hardware and leasing rebound; Hang Seng down 1%; JD.com plunges 7%

summary.zh: A股三大股指午后集体上涨，科创50涨超2%，算力硬件与算力租赁板块大幅反弹。港股恒指跌1%，京东大跌7%。
summary.en: China’s three major A-share indices rose in the afternoon, with the STAR 50 up more than 2% as computing-power hardware and leasing stocks rebounded. Hong Kong’s Hang Seng fell 1%, while JD.com dropped 7%.

reports.title: A股三大股指午后齐涨，科创50涨超2%，算力硬件、算力租赁大反弹，恒指跌1%，京东大跌7% - 华尔街见闻

title.zh: 欧盟委员会被指粉饰数据以向埃及发放资金
title.en: European Commission accused of sugarcoating figures to release funds to Egypt

summary.zh: 泄露文件质疑欧盟委员会称埃及已满足福利目标、从而有资格获得25亿欧元贷款的说法。该争议涉及欧盟2024年与埃及达成的74亿欧元协议。
summary.en: Leaked documents raise questions over the European Commission’s claim that Egypt met welfare targets to qualify for €2.5bn in loans. The dispute concerns a €7.4bn EU deal with Egypt agreed in 2024.

reports.title: European Commission accused of sugarcoating figures to release funds to Egypt

title.zh: 马斯克称黄仁勋不可替代，并对自己在美国中期选举中的政治支出表示后悔
title.en: Musk says Jensen Huang is irreplaceable, regrets midterm spending

summary.zh: 在Dealbook峰会上，马斯克称英伟达CEO黄仁勋不可替代，并对自己的美国中期选举政治支出表示后悔。他还在会上谈及SpaceX与特斯拉之间的业务重叠。
summary.en: At the Dealbook Summit, Elon Musk called Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang irreplaceable and said he regrets his spending on U.S. midterm elections. He also discussed overlaps between SpaceX and Tesla.

reports.title: Musk says Jensen Huang is irreplaceable, regrets midterm spending
Elon Musk says ousting Jensen Huang is like ‘kicking Michael Jordan off your team’

title.zh: 安谋科技解析Arm Cortex-M42，发布“星辰100e”AIoT原型平台
title.en: Arm China Details Arm Cortex-M42 and Launches 'Xingchen 100e' AIoT Prototype Platform

summary.zh: 安谋科技对Arm Cortex-M42处理器架构进行深度技术解析，并同步推出名为“星辰100e”的AIoT原型平台，面向物联网终端开发。该平台旨在为生态伙伴提供芯片与算法验证的硬件基础。
summary.en: Arm China gave an in-depth technical breakdown of the Arm Cortex-M42 processor and unveiled its "Xingchen 100e" AIoT prototype platform for IoT device development. The platform is intended to give ecosystem partners hardware for chip and algorithm validation.

reports.title: 闪电快讯 | 安谋科技深度解析Arm Cortex-M42，发布“星辰100e”AIoT原型平台 - Jiemian.com

title.zh: 为什么大多数陨石都在无人区被找到？｜科学
title.en: Why Are Most Meteorites Found in Uninhabited Areas? | Science

summary.zh: 财新科学栏目解释为何大多数陨石在无人区被找到。文章围绕陨石坠落分布、人类活动与搜索条件等因素展开分析。
summary.en: A Caixin science article explains why most meteorites are found in uninhabited areas. It examines factors such as meteorite distribution, human activity, and search conditions.

reports.title: 为什么大多数陨石都在无人区被找到？｜科学 - 财新

title.zh: 企业分拆正在失控
title.en: Corporate spin-offs are getting out of control

summary.zh: 企业分拆浪潮正在加速，甚至显现失控迹象。分拆并非万能药：部分案例带来估值释放和聚焦红利，但也有不少结果不佳。文章据此审视分拆热潮的成因、成败差异与潜在风险，值得关注公司战略和资本市场的人深入阅读。
summary.en: Corporate spin-offs are proliferating, and the trend is beginning to look unruly. Some deals have been enormously successful, but many have not, and outcomes vary widely. The article examines why spin-offs are so popular and what separates winners from losers. It is worth reading for anyone tracking corporate strategy, capital allocation, and market risk.

title.zh: 数字中的世界：国家
title.en: The world in numbers: Countries

summary.zh: 本文以数据为线索审视各国，比较人口、经济与社会等指标的变化与差异。跨国对照让读者更直观地看到共同趋势与结构性差别。数据叙事能快速建立宏观图景，也提示关注指标定义与统计局限。适合希望用较少时间把握全球概貌的读者。
summary.en: This data-driven piece examines countries through comparative indicators, spanning population, economy and society. Cross-country comparisons make shared trends and structural differences easier to grasp. It offers a quick macro picture while inviting scrutiny of definitions and statistical limits. Worth reading for a concise, quantitative view of global affairs.

title.zh: 美国大幅削减海外生物医学科学经费
title.en: America has slashed funding for biomedical science abroad

summary.zh: 美国大幅削减海外生物医学科学经费，并削弱对未来拨款使用情况的监督。这一变化牵动全球科研合作、公共卫生能力与资金问责之间的平衡。值得深入阅读，以理解政策转向对国际研究格局和治理的影响。
summary.en: The United States has sharply cut funding for biomedical science abroad and weakened oversight of how future grants are spent. The shift raises questions about global research collaboration, public-health capacity, and accountability for international funding. It is worth reading for how these changes may reshape international science and governance.

title.zh: “火神”火箭失利或将在未来数年困扰美国航天
title.en: The Vulcan rocket failure could haunt U.S. spaceflight for years to come

summary.zh: 联合发射联盟新一代“火神”火箭再度受挫，对公司及其亚马逊、NASA、美国太空军等客户构成沉重打击。文章分析此次失利的影响与后续连锁反应，并解释它为何可能长期牵动美国航天发射格局。值得深入阅读，以理解单一火箭故障如何波及国家航天能力与商业竞争。
summary.en: The latest failure of Vulcan, United Launch Alliance’s next-generation rocket, is a serious setback for the company and customers including Amazon, NASA and the U.S. Space Force. The article examines the immediate damage and the longer-term consequences for U.S. launch capacity and competition. It is worth reading for a clear view of how one rocket’s troubles can shape national spaceflight for years.

title.zh: 为何重大科技故障会集中爆发
title.en: Why so many critical tech outages are happening all at once

summary.zh: 微软、苹果、多家航空公司乃至美国国家安全局近日接连出现重大技术故障，表面看是巧合，背后可能指向同一类问题。文章梳理这些事件的共性与差异，追问它们究竟只是孤立失误的叠加，还是数字化基础设施高度集中、彼此耦合过深所暴露出的系统性脆弱。对于依赖云服务与网络系统的机构来说，这是一份关于风险认知的提醒，值得细读。
summary.en: Microsoft, Apple, airlines and even the U.S. National Security Agency have all suffered major technology failures within days of one another. This piece asks whether the clustering is coincidence or a symptom of deeper fragility: concentrated cloud dependence, tightly coupled systems and single points of failure. Worth reading for anyone who runs or relies on critical digital infrastructure.

title.zh: 档案重播：暗水——一生一次的冒险如何变成悲剧（播客）
title.en: From the archive: Dark waters: how the adventure of a lifetime turned to tragedy – podcast

summary.zh: 本期重播2023年长读《暗水》：Clipper环球帆船赛为追求终极挑战的业余选手而设，但主办方与参赛者是否低估了风险？萨莉·威廉姆斯追述那段从梦想航程滑向悲剧的经过，由克莱尔·科贝特朗读，并附作者新写的引言。在极限赛事的浪漫叙事背后，是普通人的代价与责任追问，值得细读。
summary.en: This archive episode revisits Sally Williams's 2023 long read on the Clipper Round the World yacht race, created for amateurs seeking the ultimate challenge, and asks whether the risks were underestimated. Read by Clare Corbett, with a new introduction from the author. It is worth reading for its careful account of how an adventure of a lifetime became a tragedy, and what that says about the romance and responsibility of extreme sport.
